purpose: Nutrient recommendation table for the SIH1639 Fertilizer Optimizer (Phase 0, Task 0.4).

changelog.note: Initial table. Base RDF from MPKV and PDKV. Split schedule and soil-test rule both pending.

R1: MPKV paddy source re-read in full at layout fidelity; confirmed it contains exactly one split schedule, belonging to the drip-fertigated DSR regime only. R2: adopted the AICRP-STCR Rahuri transplanted-paddy targeted-yield equations as the soil-test-based rule. Schema extended with `sources` registry, `regime`, `base_kg_per_ha`, `value_class`, and a discriminated `soil_test_adjustment._type`.

R2a investigated in depth and CONFIRMED UNRESOLVABLE from the available sources. The compendium was shown to use both the kg P/ha and kg P2O5/ha conventions explicitly in different blocks, and a block that explicitly declares the P2O5 basis was found to have an SP range overlapping Rahuri's — so magnitude cannot discriminate between the conventions. Added machine-readable `engine_guards` that forbid computing P2O5 from real soil-test P until the basis is established.

engine_guards.rule: The recommendation engine MUST NOT compute a P2O5 dose by substituting a farmer's real Soil Health Card phosphorus value into FP2O5 = 9.40*T - 13.66*SP.
engine_guards.reason: The basis of the SP term (kg P/ha vs kg P2O5/ha) is not established by any authoritative source. See outstanding_research R2a. The two readings differ by a factor of about 2.29.
permitted_uses: Reproducing the published ready reckoner rows verbatim, where the source itself supplies the paired soil-test value and prescribed dose.
Computing FN and FK2O, whose soil-test terms (SN, SK) are unambiguously in kg/ha as printed in the source's own column heading.
forbidden_uses: Interpolating or extrapolating P2O5 from an arbitrary SP value.
Converting a Soil Health Card P reading into SP by assuming either basis.
Applying the 2.29 P-to-P2O5 factor to make the numbers 'look right'.
engine_guards.required_behaviour_until_resolved: Return the P2O5 figure as unavailable, with an explicit machine-readable reason code referencing R2a. Do not silently omit it and do not substitute the blanket RDF's 50 kg P2O5/ha in its place without labelling the substitution.
engine_guards.clears_when: outstanding_research entry R2a has status RESOLVED with a cited authoritative statement of the SP basis.

scope.note: Scope fixed in docs/scope.md (Task 0.5). Entries outside this scope are retained only where explicitly marked `in_demo_scope: false`.

provenance_policy.rule: Every numeric value in `entries` is either quoted from a published SAU/ICAR document (value_class `published`) or produced by an explicitly documented transformation of such a value (value_class `derived`). Nothing was inferred from memory, averaged, or invented.
provenance_policy.incomplete_fields: Fields no verified source supplies are null with `_status: "pending_manual_research"`. They MUST NOT be filled from memory, from a blog, or from an aggregator site. See `outstanding_research` and docs/sources.md.
provenance_policy.regime_separation: Each entry describes ONE recommendation regime (crop establishment method + irrigation + soil/zone + source). Doses, split schedules and soil-test rules are never transplanted between regimes. In particular the 12-weekly-split fertigation schedule belongs solely to the 120:60:60 drip/DSR/BBF regime and must not be rescaled onto the 100:50:50 blanket RDF.

value_classes.published: Quoted from the cited publication. `source_quote` holds the exact wording.
value_classes.derived: Computed from published values by a stated, mathematically justified transformation, recorded in `_derivation`.
value_classes.unresolved: Not supplied by any verified source. Value is null and carries `_status: "pending_manual_research"`.

units.target_yield_q_per_ha: quintal (100 kg) of produce per hectare
units.note: Published SAU/ICAR tables are per hectare. The demo land unit is the acre (docs/scope.md); conversion happens in the recommendation engine, never in this file.

known_document_defects: At least one stale running header: a page headed 'Rahuri, (Maharashtra), Rice' contains sugarcane (Adsali, var. Co 7219) data, not rice. Section headers in this compendium are therefore not reliable on their own; only the self-describing body of each block was trusted.
The crop-wise index page ranges do not always align with the printed page numbers of the blocks they point to.

The adjacent 'Rahuri, (Maharashtra), Upland paddy' block's ready reckoner disagrees with its own equations by +/-1 kg in several cells. That block was NOT adopted (out of demo scope: Rabi upland) — see docs/sources.md.

entries.condition: General recommended dose of fertilizers (RDF) for paddy as used in MPKV Rahuri recommendations. The source does NOT label it kharif, and does NOT label it transplanted. Recorded exactly as published.
entries.source_locator: 2017-18, recommendation no. 6 (integrated management module for sheath blight and stem rot of paddy)
entries.source_quote: Recommended dose of fertilizers i.e. RDF (NPK: 100:50:50 kg/ha) with or without use of briquettes.

corroboration._derivation: The source states 75:37.5:37.5 IS 75 per cent of the recommended dose. Dividing by 0.75 gives 100:50:50, which matches the RDF quoted above. This is an arithmetic consistency check on a published statement, not a new recommendation.
corroboration.source_quote: The drilling of paddy at 30 cm spacing followed by application of 75 per cent recommended dose (75: 37.5: 37.5 NPK kg per hectare = 130.5 kg Urea, 82.5 kg DAP and 62.25 kg MOP per hectare)

corroboration.note: Independently corroborated by a second Maharashtra SAU under a different, explicitly stated condition — see entry rice-mh-pdkv-vidarbha-upland.

soil_test_adjustment._note: No authoritative low/medium/high multiplier for this blanket RDF was found in any verified source, and none was invented. The soil-test-based rule adopted for this project is the AICRP-STCR targeted-yield prescription in entry `rice-mh-stcr-transplanted-rahuri`.
soil_test_adjustment._relationship_warning: The STCR equations REPLACE this blanket RDF; they do not scale it. Substituting soil test values into the STCR equations yields a complete prescription in its own right. Do not multiply this entry's 100:50:50 by anything derived from the STCR entry.

nitrogen_splits._note: R1: the full MPKV source (all 4 pages, all 20 recommendations) was read at layout fidelity. It contains exactly one nitrogen split schedule, and that schedule belongs to the 120:60:60 drip-fertigated direct-seeded regime (entry rice-mh-mpkv-dsr-drip-bbf). No split schedule for this blanket RDF, and none for transplanted paddy, exists in any verified source. Rescaling the 120:60:60 schedule onto 100:50:50 is explicitly NOT supported by the source and must not be done.

entries.condition: AICRP-STCR soil-test-and-target-yield based fertilizer prescription for transplanted paddy, Rahuri (Maharashtra) centre. This is a prescription METHOD, not a fixed dose: there is no single base_kg_per_ha, because the dose is a function of soil test values and the chosen yield target.

base_kg_per_ha._note: STCR prescribes a computed dose, not a fixed base. Use `soil_test_adjustment.equations`.

basic_data._note: Printed in the source as 'Basic Data'. NR = nutrient requirement, CS = per cent contribution from soil, CF = per cent contribution from fertilizer. Recorded for completeness; the engine does not need these to apply the equations.

soil_test_adjustment._note: This is the authoritative, crop-specific, state-specific soil-test rule adopted for R2. It supersedes the need for a generic low/medium/high multiplier. No multiplier was invented.

T.unit_source: published — the source's ready reckoner column headings read '40 q ha-1 target' and '45 q ha-1 target'

SN.unit_source: published — the source's table column heading reads 'Soil test values (kg ha-1)'

measurement_method._note: This block does not name the extractant. Elsewhere the same compendium uses Alkaline KMnO4-N. NOT recorded as fact for this block.

unit._investigated: 2026-08-16 — investigated in depth and confirmed unresolvable from available sources. Not merely un-looked-up.
unit._note: AMBIGUITY PRESERVED DELIBERATELY. The block's table heading says only 'Soil test values (kg ha-1)' and its soil-test column is headed simply 'P'. It does NOT state whether SP is kg P/ha or kg P2O5/ha. The two readings differ by a factor of about 2.29 in the prescribed P2O5 dose.

_evidence_both_conventions_are_in_use_in.where: Blocks that carry the 'Soil Test Values :' legend — e.g. Bihar (Young Alluvium Calcareous Soil), Wheat, RAU Pusa, printed page 76; and the Jharkhand red loam/laterite paddy block
_evidence_both_conventions_are_in_use_in.quote: Olsen's P expressed in kg P2O5/ha

_evidence_both_conventions_are_in_use_in.where: Critical-value style blocks elsewhere in the same compendium
_evidence_both_conventions_are_in_use_in.quote: FP2O5 = Critical value for SP = 13 kg P ha-1

unit._why_magnitude_cannot_decide: The Bihar wheat block explicitly declares the P2O5 basis AND states 'Soil phosphorus range : 4- 40 kg P2O5/ha', with a ready-reckoner SP column running 4 to 22. The Rahuri paddy SP column runs 10 to 30. The ranges overlap, so the magnitude of the SP values is compatible with BOTH conventions and cannot discriminate between them. Any inference from 'which range looks like Olsen-P' is invalid.
unit._why_the_rahuri_block_cannot_be_resolved: All eleven Rahuri (Maharashtra) blocks in this compendium use a compact template (Crop/Variety, Soil/Situation, Districts, Basic Data, Equations, reckoner) that systematically omits the 'Soil Test Values : ... expressed in ...' legend and omits the 'Soil phosphorus range' line. The omission is structural to this centre's entries, not an isolated oversight.
unit._related_but_not_determinative: MPKV Rahuri's own STCR papers from the same Soil Test Crop Response Correlation Project (Dept. of Soil Science, MPKV Rahuri) report soil test P as "Olsen's P" in kg ha-1 — e.g. an Entisol/Typic Ustorthent tomato study reporting 'Olsen-P from 16.17 to 22.63 kg ha-1'. This establishes the extractant is Olsen's P but still does NOT state the reporting basis, so it does not resolve R2a.
unit._do_not: Do not guess. Do not infer from numerical plausibility. See engine_guards GUARD-R2A-P2O5.

measurement_method._note: This block does not name the extractant. Elsewhere the same compendium uses Olsen's-P. NOT recorded as fact for this block.

SK.unit_source: published — the source's table column heading reads 'Soil test values (kg ha-1)'

measurement_method._note: This block does not name the extractant. Elsewhere the same compendium uses NH4OAc-K. NOT recorded as fact for this block.

minimum_dose._note: Printed as a footnote to the ready reckoner. Applied in the two cells where the equation yields a value at or below it. The source gives no equivalent floor for N or K2O.

published_ready_reckoner._note: Transcribed verbatim from the source. 'MIN_P2O5' marks cells printed as '25*'. Retained so any future engine output can be regression-checked against the published table.

consistency_check._derivation: Each of the 30 cells of the published ready reckoner was recomputed from the three equations and compared with the printed value. All 30 agree: the 28 numeric cells match to the printed integer, and the 2 cells printed as '25*' are exactly those where the P2O5 equation yields a value at or below the published 25 kg minimum (-33.8 and +13.2).
consistency_check.method: performed by hand, not by an executed script
consistency_check.purpose: The source PDF is OCR output (ABBYY PDF Transformer+), so digits could in principle be misrecognised. The equation coefficients and the table cells are printed in separate places on the page, so exact agreement across all 30 cells is strong evidence that both were read correctly.
consistency_check.rounding_note: Reproducing the published cell at T=40, SP=25 (equation gives exactly 34.5, table prints 35) requires round-half-up. Python's built-in round() uses banker's rounding and would give 34. The engine must round half away from zero to match the published table.
consistency_check.caveat: This check validates internal consistency of the transcription. It does NOT resolve the SP unit ambiguity above, which no amount of internal arithmetic can settle.

nitrogen_splits._note: STCR prescribes rates, not timing. The compendium states explicitly that the computed quantity 'will be applied through suitable method and time of application i.e. stage of crop', leaving timing to other guidance. This source therefore does not close the R1 gap.

entries._out_of_scope_reason: Upland irrigated, western Vidarbha, variety-specific. Retained as independent corroboration of the 100:50:50 figure, not as the demo recommendation.
entries.condition: Upland irrigated condition, western Vidarbha, rice variety Avishkar. The source additionally recommends FeSO4 @ 25 kg/ha and MnSO4 @ 5 kg/ha at sowing — micronutrients, not part of the NPK dose.
entries.source_locator: Section 3.a Natural Resource Management / Agronomy, item 3
entries.source_quote: Sowing of rice variety Avishkar is recommended under upland irrigated condition of western Vidarbha with the fertilizer dose of 100:50:50 kg NPK ha-1 (RDF) along with FeSO4 @ 25 kg ha-1 and MnSO4 @ 5 kg ha-1 at the time of sowing for obtaining iron and manganese enriched higher rice grain yield, grain protein, carbohydrate content and economic returns.

soil_test_adjustment._note: Not present in this source. The cited PDKV document publishes STCR targeted-yield equations for safflower (attributed to JNKVV, Jabalpur) and sunflower (attributed to MPKV, Rahuri) only — none for rice.

entries._out_of_scope_reason: Direct-seeded on broad bed and furrow under drip fertigation — a different establishment method and irrigation system from the demo scenario. Retained because it is the ONLY regime with a source-verified split schedule.

regime.establishment_method: direct-seeded on broad bed and furrow (BBF)
regime.irrigation: drip at 100% ETc on alternate days, with fertigation
regime.zone_or_soil: medium deep soils of Western Maharashtra

entries.condition: Drip-fertigated direct-seeded paddy. THIS REGIME'S DOSE AND SPLIT SCHEDULE BELONG TOGETHER AND TO NOTHING ELSE. The 120:60:60 dose and the 12-weekly-split percentages are a single published package; neither may be applied to the 100:50:50 blanket RDF or to transplanted paddy.
entries.source_quote: Drip irrigation with 100 % ETc water at alternate day with fertigation of recommended dose (120 : 60: 60 kg N,P2O5 and K2O ha-1) in the form of water soluble fertilizers in 12 weekly splits as per following schedule is recommended for higher productivity, net returns, efficient water and nutrient use for direct seeded paddy on BBF in medium deep soils of Western Maharashtra.

soil_test_adjustment._note: Not present in this source. The STCR entry is for TRANSPLANTED paddy and must not be applied to this direct-seeded drip regime.

nitrogen_splits._basis: Table 'Fertilizer Schedule: Per cent nutrients to be applied in 12 weekly splits', transcribed verbatim from the cited source.
nitrogen_splits._source_label_note: The source labels the final block '64-91 (3 weeks)'; 64-91 days after sowing spans four weeks. The label discrepancy is in the published document and is reproduced here unaltered rather than silently corrected.

entries._out_of_scope_reason: Lowland paddy of the Western Ghat Zone — a different agro-climatic zone from the demo scenario.

corroboration.note: The same GRD is restated in the 2016-17 silicon recommendation.
corroboration.source_quote: GRD (10 tonnes FYM ha-1, 56 kg N & 30 kg P2O5 through Urea-DAP briquettes & 50 kg k2O ha-1)

nitrogen_splits._note: Not present in this source. The source describes briquette placement, not a timed split.

entries._out_of_scope_reason: Lowland paddy of the Western Ghat Zone under a briquette-only nutrient package.

entries.condition: DISTINCT from rice-mh-mpkv-lowland-western-ghat-grd despite the similar N and P2O5 figures: this is a briquette-only package at 56:30:30, whereas the GRD entry is 56:30:50 with 10 t FYM. Recorded separately so the two are not conflated.

outstanding_research.item: Nitrogen split schedule for TRANSPLANTED kharif paddy in Maharashtra, applicable to the 100:50:50 blanket RDF.
outstanding_research.what_was_ruled_out: The full MPKV paddy source (4 pages, 20 recommendations, 2009-10 to 2019-20) was re-read at layout fidelity. It contains exactly one split schedule, belonging to the 120:60:60 drip-fertigated DSR/BBF regime. The AICRP-STCR compendium prescribes rates only and explicitly defers timing. The PDKV 2021 recommendations contain no split for rice.
outstanding_research.why_not_filled: Rescaling the 120:60:60 fertigation percentages onto the 100:50:50 transplanted regime is not supported by any source: different establishment method, different irrigation system, different fertilizer form, different application count.
outstanding_research.candidate_source: MPKV Rahuri, Krishi Darshani 2023 — https://mpkv.ac.in/Uploads/Publication/Krishi%20Darshani%20%202023_20230607043125.pdf (approx. 58 MB, 491 pages, Marathi). The PDF is typeset in a legacy non-Unicode Marathi font, so machine text extraction yields mojibake and row-to-number attribution is unreliable.
outstanding_research.what_to_capture: Percentage or kg of N applied at each stage (basal / at transplanting, tillering, panicle initiation), with page number and a verbatim quote.
outstanding_research.safe_prototype_behaviour: The engine must NOT emit a split schedule for the transplanted regime. It should return the total seasonal N with an explicit flag that timing guidance is unavailable, rather than inventing stages.

outstanding_research.item: Soil-test-based adjustment rule for rice in Maharashtra.
outstanding_research.resolution: Adopted the AICRP-STCR targeted-yield fertilizer prescription equations for transplanted paddy at the Rahuri (Maharashtra) centre — entry `rice-mh-stcr-transplanted-rahuri`, source ICAR-IISS-STCR-4DECADES. This is a crop-specific, state-specific, soil-test-driven prescription and it removes any need for a generic low/medium/high multiplier. No multiplier was invented.

outstanding_research.item: Basis of the SP (soil test phosphorus) term in the Rahuri transplanted-paddy STCR equation: kg P/ha or kg P2O5/ha?
outstanding_research.why_it_matters: The two readings differ by a factor of about 2.29 in the P2O5 dose the equation prescribes. Blocking for any real soil-test input.

investigation_performed.step: Inspected the source block and its surroundings (printed page 114 and adjacent pages).
investigation_performed.finding: The Rahuri transplanted-paddy block states no extractant and no P basis. Its soil-test column is headed simply 'P'.

investigation_performed.step: Searched the whole 280-page compendium for every occurrence of a units legend.
investigation_performed.finding: Six 'Soil Test Values :' legends exist (Jharkhand and Bihar blocks); every one of them says P is 'expressed in kg P2O5/ha'. However, other blocks in the same document express SP elementally: 'FP2O5 = Critical value for SP = 13 kg P ha-1'. The document therefore uses BOTH conventions and has no single document-wide rule.

investigation_performed.step: Checked whether the magnitude of the SP values could discriminate.
investigation_performed.finding: It cannot. The Bihar wheat block explicitly declares the P2O5 basis and has an SP range of 4-40 (reckoner column 4-22); the Rahuri paddy SP column is 10-30. The ranges overlap, so both conventions are numerically plausible. Rejected as a basis for inference.

investigation_performed.step: Checked all eleven Rahuri (Maharashtra) blocks in the compendium for the centre's own convention.
investigation_performed.finding: All eleven use a compact template that systematically omits both the units legend and the 'Soil phosphorus range' line. The omission is structural to this centre's entries.

investigation_performed.step: Attempted the official AICRP-STCR portal for canonical notation (aicrp.icar.gov.in/stcr/).
investigation_performed.finding: Domain did not resolve (DNS ENOTFOUND) on repeated attempts. Not consulted.

investigation_performed.step: Consulted a peer-reviewed STCR paper from the same MPKV Rahuri Soil Test Crop Response Correlation Project on the same Typic Ustorthent soil.
investigation_performed.finding: Confirms the extractant is Olsen's P reported in kg ha-1 (e.g. 'Olsen-P from 16.17 to 22.63 kg ha-1'), but does not state the reporting basis. Narrows the question without answering it.

outstanding_research.why_still_pending: No authoritative source consulted states the basis for this block, and the one line of purely numerical reasoning that might have suggested an answer was tested and found invalid (ranges overlap). Filling it in would require a guess.
outstanding_research.what_to_capture: An authoritative statement of the reporting basis for the Rahuri centre's Olsen's-P soil test — e.g. from the AICRP-STCR Rahuri centre's own bulletin, the MPKV Department of Soil Science, or the AICRP-STCR portal once reachable.
outstanding_research.fastest_route_to_resolution: Contact the AICRP-STCR centre at the Department of Soil Science and Agricultural Chemistry, MPKV Rahuri, and ask directly whether SP in their published targeted-yield equations is Olsen's P as measured (kg P/ha) or converted to kg P2O5/ha.
outstanding_research._enforced_by_note: Resolves against the top-level `engine_guards` array by `id`.
outstanding_research.safe_prototype_behaviour: The engine must not compute a P2O5 dose from a farmer's real Soil Health Card P value using this equation. FN and FK2O are unaffected and may be computed. Either restrict the demo to the published ready-reckoner rows, or surface P2O5 as unavailable with a reason code referencing R2a.

outstanding_research.item: Confirmation that the 100:50:50 RDF is the kharif, transplanted figure.
outstanding_research.why_it_matters: MPKV states 100:50:50 as the general paddy RDF without qualifying season or establishment method. The demo scope is specifically kharif transplanted paddy.
outstanding_research.what_to_capture: A kharif-and-transplanted-specific figure from an official Maharashtra Package of Practices, with source and URL.
